from pathlib import Path

 p=ROOT/path;b=p.read_bytes();return json.loads(b),{'file':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}

 assert d['_meta']['end'] and d['_meta']['exit_code']==86 and m['producer_exit_code']==86 and m['black_frame_detected'] is True and m['errors']==m['cleanup_errors']==[]
 assert g['_meta']['exit_code']==86 and g['metrics']['passed'] is False and m['gate']['sha256']==gr['sha256']
 obs=g['metrics']['devices'][0]['observation'];f=final[job]
 rows.append({'job_id':job,'arm':arm,'result_reference':r,'gate_reference':gr,'original_meta':{k:d['_meta'][k] for k in ('name','start','end','exit_code')},'original_metrics':m,'node':obs['node'],'gpu_uuid':obs['gpu_identity']['gpu_uuid'],'allocation_gpu_hours':f['gpu_hours'],'queue_charge_rate':f['queue_charge_rate'],'charged_gpu_hours':f['gpu_hours']*f['queue_charge_rate'],'queue_wait_seconds':account['metrics']['queue_wait_seconds_by_job'][job]})
old=base['subbudgets']['E2Epilot']['actual_charged_gpu_hours'];new=sum(r['charged_gpu_hours'] for r in rows);total=old+new
report={'observed_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Original opening-black failures and canonical fees; no training update, no resubmission, no resource validation of prospective requests.','prior_ledger_reference':baseref,'canonical_reference':accountref,'rows':rows,'pilot_actual_before_gpu_hours':old,'new_black_cost_gpu_hours':new,'pilot_actual_after_gpu_hours':total,'pilot_queued_or_running_reservations_after_these_two_ended_gpu_hours':0.0,'known_scope':'Through these two original submissions; future requests require submitter fresh budget validation','nine_hour_reservation_math':{'same_two_13175_requests_plus_actual_seconds':total*3600+2*13175,'max_equal_integer_seconds_per_new_request':int((9*3600-total*3600)//2),'scope':'Arithmetic only, not existing same-resource pinned-retry validator approval'}}
out=ROOT/'logs/review'/NAME;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False);p=out/'report.json'
with p.open('x') as f:json.dump(report,f,sort_keys=True,indent=2)
brief={k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='rows'};brief['rows']=[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='original_metrics'} for r in rows];brief['report']={'file':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
